race.comment: VALLEY STAR (4) showed plenty of ability as a juvenile, winning 2 of his 4 starts, and finishing runner-up in his other outings. He resumes here without any public trials which is the only query, but on raw ability, he is the one to beat. BUZZOFFSKI (5) was also a very talented juvenile, winning 2 of her 4 starts. She is perfectly drawn for her return, and is suited by racing over 1000m. Hard to beat, so follow any market confidence. ZUNI (7) should have no fitness concerns third up from a spell, and she should get the genuine tempo that she needs up top in this race. Watch for her late. Each way. NAVARRE RIVER (1) made progress last season, and he resumes from a spell that would have done him the world of good. This trip is well short of his best, but if they overdo it in front, he will be taking plenty of ground off the front-runners. Don't risk him. STREET DIVA (2) has been a tad disappointing over 1200m in 2 runs back from a spell, and dropping back to 1000m could be the key.
